map.核心计算公式（按输入变量）：idleP×(t×(100-duty)÷100)÷6: Core formulas (by input variable): idleP×(t×(100-duty)÷100)÷60; Parc÷(eff÷100); Pin×duty÷100
map.💡 电弧功率 P = U × I ÷ 1000（kW）；考虑焊机效率与负载持续率: 💡 Arc power P = U × I ÷ 1000 (kW); actual energy consumption and electricity cost are computed after accounting for machine efficiency and duty cycle.
map.负载持续率（暂载率）为燃弧时间占总时间比例，60% 为常见值: The duty cycle (formerly called intermittent duty factor) is the fraction of total time spent arcing; 60% is a common value
map.计算结果仅供参考，实际能耗受焊机型号与工况影响: The results are for reference only; actual consumption depends on the machine model and working conditions
map.📚 深度解析：焊接能耗成本核算: 📚 In-depth analysis: welding energy cost accounting
map.按电流、电压、负载持续率与焊机效率计算电弧功率与实际耗电量，核算单班或单件电费。: Calculate arc power and real power consumption from current, voltage, duty cycle and machine efficiency to account for electricity cost per shift or per part.
map.计入焊机空载损耗，评估通过减少空载时间可节省的电费。: Include the no-load loss of the welding machine and evaluate the savings available from cutting idle time.
map.比较不同焊接方法或设备的能耗水平，做节能改造的经济性判断。: Compare the energy level of different welding methods or equipment to judge the economics of an energy-saving retrofit.
map.电弧功率 Parc(kW) = 电压 × 电流 ÷ 1000；焊机输入功率 Pi: Arc power Parc (kW) = voltage × current ÷ 1000; machine input power Pin = Parc ÷ efficiency (%)×100; average power Pavg = Pin × duty cycle ÷ 100; arcing time (min) = total time × duty cycle ÷ 100; arcing energy E (kWh) = Pavg × total time (min) ÷ 60; electricity cost = E × unit price. No-load power is estimated at 10% of the arc power; adding it gives total energy and total cost.
map.电流 200 A、电压 25 V、效率 85%、负载持续率 60%、工作 60: Current 200 A, voltage 25 V, efficiency 85%, duty cycle 60%, 60 min of work, electricity price CNY 0.8/kWh: Parc = 5.0 kW; Pin = 5.0/0.85 ≈ 5.88 kW; Pavg = 3.53 kW; arcing time 36 min; arcing energy = 3.53×60/60 = 3.53 kWh, electricity cost about CNY 2.82. The 24 min of idling at 0.5 kW adds about 0.20 kWh, giving total energy about 3.73 kWh and total cost about CNY 2.98.
map.负载持续率为什么影响能耗？: Why does the duty cycle affect energy consumption?
map.焊机并非全程燃弧，负载持续率反映燃弧时间占比；断续焊接时输入功率虽高但平均能耗低: The machine does not arc the whole time, and the duty cycle reflects the arcing fraction. With intermittent welding the input power is high but average consumption is low, while idling still draws power (about 10% of the arc power), so cutting idle waiting is an effective energy-saving measure.
map.提高焊机效率能省多少？: How much can a more efficient machine save?
map.效率从 70% 提到 85% 时，输入功率下降约 18%，长期运行节省明显；逆变: Raising efficiency from 70% to 85% lowers input power by about 18%, which is a clear long-run saving. Inverter welders are usually more efficient than conventional arc welding transformers, which is why they are the main direction for energy-saving retrofits.
